sources.title: Xiangshan Global Studios
sources.excerpt: Xiangshan Global Studios is a film and television studio in Xinqiao Town of Xiangshan County, Zhejiang, China. The 784,000-square-metre (194-acre) studio was established in 2003 and opened to the public in 2005. It was rated an AAAA-level tourist site by the China National Tourism Administration on November 7, 2012.
